aaron rodgers.note: Rostered (claimed by Def Not Kira on waivers this morning) - no longer available.

alvin kamara.note: RotoBaller's #1 on opportunity alone, but the profile is a trap: 31 years old, DNP Wednesday (back) on a short week, splitting the backfield with Kendre Miller and rookie CJ Donaldson in a committee - and Etienne (IR) is eligible back Week 9. Bid only if desperate.

antonio williams.note: 73% route rate, 8 targets, 12.6 expected points as WAS's WR2 with McLaurin (hamstring, Q) sidelined - and the QB fear is gone with Jayden Daniels back off the injury report.

brenton strange.note: 7-of-8 for 95 yards in Week 4; the role is real, but JAX spreads targets (BTJ, Meyers, Washington, Tuten) and the TD hasn't come yet.

brian robinson jr..note: 15 touches for 67 yards and 3 TDs in Week 4's rout of New Orleans; 10+ touches in three straight games. ATL feeds its backs - stash for role growth, not startable yet.

chris bell.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by Kenny's rule.

cj donaldson.note: NO rookie matching Kamara snap-for-snap in the three-way committee; if the veteran's back issue lingers, Donaldson is the cheapest path to the role.

cyrus allen.note: KC rookie (20% rostered) who drew camp hype; Rice (hamstring, multi-week) and Thornton (ankle, out indefinitely) could force a real route share - but KC is on bye in Week 5 and he's unproven. Deep stash only.

darius cooper.note: 3 catches for 33 yards but 2 TDs in Week 4 (3 TDs on 5 catches this season - obvious regression coming); role dies when DeVonta Smith (hamstring, Q) returns. Red-zone dart only.

deshaun watson.note: CLE garbage offense - excluded by Kenny's rule.

devaughn vele.note: 84%+ snaps for NO but no verified target volume to justify the roster spot. Skip.

dohnte meyers.note: 90% routes and 7-82 as CIN's injury fill-in with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) iffy, but the talent check says no: 4-47 through his first three NFL games. Kenny's explicit opportunity-without-talent example.

emanuel wilson.note: 60% of snaps and 76% of backfield opportunities in Week 4 (21-81-1 rushing, 3-39-1 receiving, 24 touches/120 yds) as SEA's lead back with Price (chest) on IR and Charbonnet (ACL recovery) ruled out Week 5. Caveat: 3.6 YPC tempers it, Charbonnet is practicing, and SEA just signed Joe Mixon (inactive since 2024) - bid a 2-4 week starter, not a season answer.

jacoby brissett.note: Locked in as ARI's starter and DET allows the most fantasy points to QBs - but he's 2-13 as ARI's starter and just threw 3 INTs (55.2 rating). One-week streamer only.

jakobi meyers.note: 10 catches on 12 targets with a TD over his last two games as JAX's starting perimeter WR; PPR flex floor.

jalon daniels.note: TB's UDFA rookie QB (19-of-27 for 148-1-2, 8-55 rushing in first start); starts 2-5 weeks with a legs-based floor - but one-QB leagues can't roster a project.

jameis winston.note: 250-3-2 vs ARI (QB9 entering Monday night), starting while Jaxson Dart is out; gets a WAS defense that's allowed the second-most points above expectation - classic Jameis streamer volatility.

jaylen wright.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by Kenny's rule.

jordyn tyson.note: IR stash with a possible Week 7-9 return; talented rookie with multi-week runway once active.

kaelon black.note: SF rookie RB sitting #3-5 on FantasyPros PPR waiver lists; the 49ers backfield is always one injury from relevance - deep stash, not startable.

keaton mitchell.note: 15 touches (10-39 rushing, 5-24 receiving) in Week 4 with usage trending up, but it's a three-way LAC split and he's a big-play back, not a volume back. Boom-bust PPR bench piece.

kendre miller.note: 19-of-74 snaps in NO's three-way split behind Kamara and Donaldson; touchdown-dependent flex at best. Skip.

kenyon sadiq.note: No verified route/target edge on a bad Jets offense - don't pay for the name.

keon coleman.note: Career game in Week 4: 6-of-7 for 116 yards and a TD, led BUF's WRs in snaps; 14-of-16 catches on the season with the 2nd-most routes on the team. D.J. Moore (shoulder, AC joint) aggravated it again - Schefter says not long-term, but Moore could still miss Monday night vs the Rams, opening a rental window on a 31.8-ppg offense with real third-year breakout trajectory.

khalil shakir.note: FantasyPros consensus #3: most routes on BUF, 7-of-8 for 82 in Week 4, 6+ targets in 3 of 4 games - the high-floor Bill. Gets a target boost while D.J. Moore (shoulder) is out; 42% rostered so rarely available.

kirk cousins.note: Rostered (won by DOOM $6-to-$3 on waivers this morning) - no longer available.

malik washington.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by Kenny's rule.

michael mayer.note: 73-78% route share the last two weeks and 8-of-9 for 82 yards in Week 4 - LV's clear second pass-catcher behind Bowers with genuine every-week TE2 usage.

michael penix jr..note: Sharp in Week 3 (18-26-256-1) with a real Drake London connection; gets BAL (just torched by Cam Ward) - one-QB streamer at best.

mike gesicki.note: 11-155-3 on 15 targets with TDs in 3 of 4 games; 61.8% snap share in Week 4 (season high) with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) out, and MIA's TE-battered defense up in Week 5. But 3 TDs on 11 catches is touchdown-dependent and the role shrinks when the WRs return - one-week rental.

mike washington jr..note: Top one-injury-away RB stash behind Jeanty in LV; pure handcuff until the backfield opens.

nicholas singleton.note: TEN rookie RB; Pollard (expiring deal) is a logical trade candidate and Singleton would have the leg up on early-down work - deep end-of-bench stash.

ollie gordon ii.note: RotoBaller's #3, but MIA is a garbage offense - excluded by Kenny's rule. (Also already on Kenny's bench.)

roman wilson.note: 6.0 targets/game looks fine until you see 19 or fewer routes in each of the last two games with Pittman playing - no real role. Skip.

romeo doubs.note: 6-of-9 for 58 yards and 2 TDs in Week 4 (12/203/2 on the season) as NE's starting flanker; targets rising weekly (96 yds, 49 yds, then 9 targets) in a Drake Maye offense that just beat Buffalo. A.J. Brown (ankle) is also on this roster, so target competition tightens when Brown returns.

t.j. hockenson.note: 13-of-13 for 119 yards (tied career high in catches) on 83% of snaps with Jefferson (ankle, limited Wednesday) out and Oliver (biceps) on IR; 22-195 on the season. The catch: MIN sits near the bottom in total offense, and the value evaporates the moment Jefferson returns.

tank bigsby.note: Placed on IR Monday - core-muscle surgery, out ~6 weeks (per Rapoport). FanDuel's published #2 predates the news; there is no role to add right now. Will Shipley is the Eagles backfield add.

tory horton.note: Snap share declining three straight weeks (31% to 17%) - the coaches are telling you the role is shrinking. Skip.

tre' harris.note: 93% of snaps in Week 4 (77% on the year), 13 catches for 209 yards on 21 targets as LAC's starting flanker; McConkey (foot) is week-to-week. Startable while McConkey is out, but the path closes on his return - rental, not stash.

tyler allgeier.note: Listed RB1 on ARI's Week 5 depth chart and handling goal-line work, but Jeremiyah Love's snap share is climbing (55% since Week 3) while Allgeier's fell to 36% - TD-dependent handcuff, not a flex.

tyler higbee.note: 13-129-1 on 17 targets over two games with a 77% route rate while Ferguson (ankle, IR) and Parkinson (shoulder) are out - legitimate TE streamer.

tyreek hill.note: Free agent targeting a November return from the multi-ligament knee injury; KC has reached out (Thornton/Rice injuries) and his agent is negotiating with multiple teams - ceiling stash only with bench space to burn.

wan'dale robinson.note: Kenny dropped him for the Stroud Week 5 claim; TEN offense, redundant slot profile - leave him on waivers.

will shipley.note: 29 snaps and 15 routes in Week 4 relief (6-23-0) as the last man standing with Barkley (hamstring, week-to-week, unlikely Week 5) and Bigsby (core-muscle surgery) headed to IR - the likely lead back at Jacksonville. He's never topped 100 rushing yards in a season, so this is a rental, not a breakout.

xavier worthy.note: Finally flashed in Week 4 (70 yards, doubling his season total) and KC's WR room is in triage - Thornton (ankle) out indefinitely, Rice (hamstring) multi-week. But KC is on bye in Week 5 and the passing game is struggling, so this is a role-growth stash, not a plug-and-play.

zach charbonnet.note: Practicing but ruled out for Week 5 by Macdonald; debut no sooner than Week 6-7 with a 'prominent role' promised. Bench stash only - doesn't dent Wilson's Week 5 value.

picks.name: Emanuel Wilson
picks.why: 60% of snaps and 76% of backfield opportunities in Week 4: 21 carries for 81 yards and a TD plus 3 catches for 39 yards and another score (24 touches, 120 scrimmage yards). Lead back with rookie Jadarian Price (chest) on IR and Zach Charbonnet ruled out for Week 5 - but 3.6 YPC tempers it, Charbonnet is practicing, and SEA just signed Joe Mixon (inactive since 2024) as depth.

picks.name: T.J. Hockenson
picks.why: 13-of-13 for 119 yards (tied career high in catches) on 83% of snaps with Justin Jefferson (ankle, limited Wednesday) out and Josh Oliver on IR; 22 catches for 195 yards on the season. The catch: the value evaporates the moment Jefferson returns, and Minnesota sits near the bottom in total offense.

picks.name: Alvin Kamara
picks.why: RotoBaller's #1 on pure opportunity with Travis Etienne on IR (eligible to return Week 9) - Kamara cashed in 2 rushing TDs Monday night vs Atlanta. But he's 31, did not practice Wednesday (back) on a short week, and splits the backfield with Kendre Miller and rookie CJ Donaldson. The consensus math puts him here; the profile says trap.

picks.name: Tank Bigsby
picks.why: FanDuel's published #2 predates the news: Bigsby was placed on IR Monday and needs core-muscle surgery (out ~6 weeks per Rapoport). He had 14 carries for 55 yards after Saquon Barkley (hamstring) exited in Week 4, but there is no role to add right now - Will Shipley is the Eagles backfield add.

picks.name: Khalil Shakir
picks.why: FantasyPros consensus #3: most routes among Bills WRs, 7-of-8 for 82 yards in Week 4, 6+ targets in 3 of 4 games - the high-floor Bill. D.J. Moore aggravated his shoulder (AC joint) and could miss Monday night vs the Rams; Schefter says it's not long-term, but Shakir gets a target boost while Moore is out.
